title: All Foreign Gifts Around Us
description: Tangible gifts given to U.S. federal employees by foreign governments, extracted from Federal Register notices (calendar years 2005-2022).
source: Federal Register: Office of Protocol, Gifts to Federal Employees From Foreign Government Sources

gifts.description: One row per reported gift. Source text is preserved in name_and_title and foreign_donor; recipient_name/title and donor_name/title/country are parsed out of those fields.

columns.name_and_title: Recipient's full name and title as printed in the Federal Register notice.
columns.estimated_value: Estimated value in USD. Null where the source listed a non-numeric value (e.g. "Unknown", "In appraisal process"); ranges (e.g. "1000-1500") resolve to the low end.
columns.disposition: What happened to the gift (e.g. "Transferred to NARA").
columns.foreign_donor: Donor's full name, title, and country as printed in the Federal Register notice.
columns.donor_name: Donor name, honorifics removed. Blank when the recipient is an anonymous agency employee.
columns.circumstances: Stated reason the gift was accepted rather than declined.

most_valuable_gifts.sql: select recipient_name, recipient_title, donor_name, donor_country, gift_description, estimated_value, received from gifts where estimated_value is not null order by estimated_value desc limit 50
most_valuable_gifts.title: Most valuable gifts

gifts_by_country.sql: select donor_country, count(*) as gift_count, sum(estimated_value) as total_value from gifts where donor_country is not null group by donor_country order by gift_count desc
gifts_by_country.title: Gifts by donor country

gifts_by_year.sql: select strftime('%Y', received) as year, count(*) as gift_count, sum(estimated_value) as total_value from gifts where received is not null and received != '' group by year order by year desc
gifts_by_year.title: Gifts by year
